payload.text: In two sentences, what is the difference between latency and throughput? Answer from your own knowledge and use no tools.

data.text: Latency is how long one operation takes from start to finish. Throughput is how many operations a system can complete per unit of time.

payload.text: Now, in two sentences, name one case where improving one of them makes the other worse. Again use no tools.

data.text: Batching requests can improve throughput by processing many at once. However, each request may wait for the batch to fill, increasing its latency.
